name: youtube-easy
description: Manage YouTube by reusing a signed-in Chromium browser or a dedicated profile. No API keys or copied cookies.
long_description: YouTube Easy reuses signed-in Helium/Chrome/Edge/Chromium sessions with the paired Easy Social Browser Companion or an existing loopback debugger, falling back to a dedicated browser profile. It verifies important fields before final Studio writes, coordinates duplicate protection and rate-limit cooldowns across separate processes, and returns UNCERTAIN instead of risking repeated ambiguous writes.
